origin: Independently authored synthetic English requests, created directly from the supplied behavioral contract by the fresh-context author role.

source_access.supplied_material: Author task instructions and custodian confirmation that ready key is the integer original input scalar code point.

no_score_attestation: No candidate was accessed or run, and no evaluation, test, or scoring was performed. Only self-authored corpus structure and internal uniqueness may be checked before delivery.
scope: Procedural fresh-context separation using the same underlying model and tools; not OS or third-party isolation.

internal_structure_check.method: Read only the authored draft to count rows, fields, families and UTF-16 length, compare internal Unicode-casefold/punctuation/whitespace-normalized strings, and compute its SHA-256. This check did not execute requests or inspect a candidate.

uncertainties_and_resolutions.resolution: Custodian confirmed integer original input scalar code point; no converted output is stored.

uncertainties_and_resolutions.issue: Valid typed proposals whose native casing may expand, cross Latin-1 boundaries, or remain unchanged
uncertainties_and_resolutions.resolution: Kept ready when the original scalar is permitted, independently of downstream native coverage.
Clarify rows explicitly present alternative candidate operands; abstain rows explicitly request whole-word or whole-string conversion.
Explicit C0, DEL and C1 control operands are abstain; printable or spacing non-control Latin-1 operands are retained as ready.
Names are not decoded or guessed; explicit name-only operands request clarification.

draft_preservation: draft1.json is permanent and must not be overwritten. Any custodian-directed repair will create a separately numbered draft.
